lines.zh: 我走走停停，耳朵一直动。
lines.en: I stop and go, ears always twitching.
I hug the wall's base, where it's dark.

lines.zh: 我步子很轻，几乎没声音。
lines.en: My steps are light, nearly silent.
I trot two steps, then look back.
I step on the seams of the tiles.

lines.zh: 我绕开亮处，走阴影那边。
lines.en: I avoid the bright spots, keeping to shade.

lines.zh: 我的爪子凉，踩过石头有响。
lines.en: My paws are cool; they click on stone.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步，隔一格。
lines.en: I follow your steps, one pace behind.
I pass a torch, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴，尾巴尖扫地。
lines.en: I drag my tail, the tip sweeping the floor.

lines.zh: 走几步，我就竖耳听一听。
lines.en: A few steps, then I prick my ears.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上跳下去，稳稳的。
lines.en: I hop off the step and land steady.

lines.zh: 我蹲在角落里，眼睛亮着。
lines.en: I crouch in the corner, eyes bright.
I curl up on a warm stone for a nap.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的脚步，不是你的。
lines.en: I hear steps far off, not yours.
I lick my paws, slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在暗处泛着冷光。
lines.en: My scales give off a cold sheen in the dark.
I count the echoes in the corridor.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀量了量宽度。
lines.en: I spread my wings, measuring the width.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕到身前抱着。
lines.en: I wrap my tail around and hug it.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出一排小牙。
lines.en: I yawn, showing a row of small teeth.

lines.zh: 我在离你不远的影里候着。
lines.en: I wait in the shade not far from you.

lines.zh: 我闻到灰和旧石头的味。
lines.en: I smell ash and old stone.
I shudder, and my scales rustle.
I stare at the shadows on the wall.
Only because you lit no lamp do I come near.
I'm behind you; don't rush.
I look up, two points of light in my eyes.
I slip into your shadow.
You come closer; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，不是别人。
lines.en: I know your scent, not someone else's.

lines.zh: 你要蹲下来我才敢过去。
lines.en: Crouch down, and then I'll dare come.

lines.zh: 我把头歪着，看你手里的光。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the light in your hand.
I make a small call, very short.
Don't move suddenly; I'll bolt.

lines.zh: 我藏在你腿后，只露眼睛。
lines.en: I hide behind your leg, only my eyes showing.
Your shadow is just big enough to hide in.
I'm not afraid of you; I'm afraid of that lamp.
Your hand comes near; I sniff it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的脚走了半圈。
lines.en: I walk half a circle around your feet.
Speak more quietly.
I look up, waiting for you to blink first.
I stand pressed against your boot.

lines.zh: 你把火把放下，我就过来。
lines.en: Put the torch down, and I'll come.
I shrink into the shadow.
One scale split.
I back into the corner, panting.
I shudder, my tail tucked.
I was slow to dodge that one.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼里的光暗了。
lines.en: I look up at you, my eyes dimmer.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔裂口，血是热的。
lines.en: I lick the split; the blood is warm.
I flatten and wait for you to leave.
That meat shines even in the dark.
I don't come to the fire, only to you.
I sniff it, then look up at you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪一步，再挪一步。
lines.en: I inch forward, then once more.
Keep your hand still, or I'll bolt.
I snatch it and dart to the corner.
It's good, but I won't say so.
Move the torch, and then I'll eat.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝上，滑到一边。
lines.en: I hit your knee and slide aside.
One touch and I retreat; I'm timid.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的翅膀折了一下。
lines.en: We collide, and my wing folds wrong.
I slip past your feet.

lines.zh: 你差点踢到我，我躲开了。
lines.en: You nearly kicked me; I dodged.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，你从我背上过去。
lines.en: I flatten, and you step over my back.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Your hand touches me, and I flinch.

lines.zh: 我们挤在墙角，我退无可退。
lines.en: We crowd a corner, and I've nowhere left.

lines.zh: 另一枚蛋在同一个箱子里。
lines.en: Another egg lay in the same chest.
We were hatched together.
She dislikes bright places too.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个阴影里。
lines.en: We crowd into the same shadow.
She rests her head on my back.
We guard that meat together.
She's quieter than I am, almost still.
We groom each other's scales, slowly.
Our two tails wind together.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，我们靠得更近。
lines.en: When the lamp dies, we draw closer.

lines.zh: 我叼起掉在暗处的骨头。
lines.en: I pick up the bone lying in the dark.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的钉子收起来。
lines.en: I gather the nail you dropped.
I dig a coal out of the ash.
I pick up a shard of broken tile.
I hug your glove and won't give it back.

lines.zh: 我把地上的箭头藏起来。
lines.en: I hide the arrowhead from the floor.
I pick up a bit of gold and stow it.
I pick up a candle; it burns my mouth.
I eat the scale I shed.

lines.zh: 我拖着一块布，拖进角落。
lines.en: I drag a cloth into the corner.

lines.zh: 它踩灭了我们唯一的灯。
lines.en: It put out our only lamp.

lines.zh: 它的脚步很重，我听见了。
lines.en: Its footsteps are heavy; I heard them.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，护在主人前面。
lines.en: I spread my wings in front of my master.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里出来，就一下。
lines.en: I come out of the shadow, just once.

lines.zh: 它的气味让我竖起了鳞。
lines.en: Its smell raises my scales.
I'm not big, but I have fire.
My throat lights up, hot.
I drop low, ready to spring.
Master, go first; I'll hold.
I count its steps: one, two.
It stands in light; I'm in the dark.
This one's mine; don't call me small.

lines.zh: 我从它的视线外绕过去。
lines.en: I circle outside its line of sight.
It raises the flame higher; I wait.
Enough shadows here to move in.

lines.zh: 我贴着地跑，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I run low, nearly unseen.

lines.zh: 它举起火把乱照，照不到我。
lines.en: It swings a torch around; it can't find me.
I stop behind its heel.
I wait for its torch to burn down.
I bite once and go.
The fire in my throat stays banked.
It turns; I press behind stone.
I count each of its breaths.
It's getting annoyed, and its moves slow.
I pass between its legs.
It retreats; I follow close.

lines.zh: 我在等一个它转不过身的位置。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a spot it can't turn in.
My scales press the stone, cool.
It kicks, and hits nothing.
A little closer and I can breathe fire.
Its breathing skipped a beat.
I breathe a jet of fire from the dark.
The fire runs along the ground.
I butt my horns into its shin.

lines.zh: 我跳到它背后，抓了一下。
lines.en: I leap to its back and claw.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我已经不在那了。
lines.en: It turns, and I'm no longer there.
That used up all my strength.
The fire catches it, and it steps back.

lines.zh: 我滚进阴影里，换个位置。
lines.en: I roll into shadow and change position.
I bite again, then withdraw.
It swings the torch; I avoid it.

lines.zh: 火在它护甲上留了黑印。
lines.en: Fire leaves a black mark on its armor.

lines.zh: 我抓它的手腕，让它松手。
lines.en: I claw its wrist until it lets go.
That one was for the lamp.
I pant, my throat burning.

lines.zh: 它踩空了一下，我扑上去。
lines.en: It misses a step, and I spring.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来时，周围很暗。
lines.en: When I came out of the egg, it was dark.

lines.zh: 壳裂开，我听见石头在响。
lines.en: The shell splits, and I hear stone.
I spent ten minutes by the fire.
I waited long at the bottom of a chest.
My scales aren't hard yet; they're soft.
I crawl out and hide in a crack.
I shake the dust off my shell.

lines.zh: 我轻轻叫了一下，你没听见。
lines.en: I chirp softly; you didn't hear.
Firelight slides over my scales.
I raise my head at that shadow.
This place has plenty of shadows.
First I'll find a corner.
My wings are still curled.
I hear someone speaking softly.
The fire is too bright; I turn and run.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，尾巴卷住了身体。
lines.en: I fall from a height, tail curling around me.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的翅膀贴在身上。
lines.en: Water floods in, and my wings cling to me.

lines.zh: 炸声太响，我耳朵里嗡嗡的。
lines.en: The blast is so loud my ears ring.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的背，鳞翻起来。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back, lifting a scale.
A light binds me; I can't break free.

lines.zh: 我饿得发抖，还是很怕光。
lines.en: I shake with hunger, still afraid of light.

lines.zh: 整条通道都亮了，我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The whole passage lights up; I can't open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我在黑里掉，连影子都没了。
lines.en: I fall through black with no shadow left.
